stories.summary: Opponents of plans to close four Catholic schools in Flintshire to create a 3-18 super-school say it undermines the new Welsh Government’s commiitment to strengthen Welsh culture. stories.title: Senedd election 2026: new Members meet for first time on Tuesday
stories.summary: The election is done. 96 Members of the Senedd have been elected, and they meet for the first time on Tuesday. They have until 3 June to pick a First Minister. stories.title: Flintshire leader Dave Hughes eyes re-election at last AGM before polls
stories.summary: Councillor Dave Hughes will ask Flintshire County Council to back him as leader for another year on Tuesday, at the chamber’s last annual meeting before next May’s elections. stories.title: BAFTA-winner Richard Elfyn leads cast of new Atlantis play at Theatr Clwyd
stories.summary: A new play about a Welsh coastal community facing rising seas will run at Theatr Clwyd in Mold from 6 June to 4 July.
